// GearboxData: CAN ID 0x200 (standard), 8 bytes, sender TCM, cycle time 20 ms
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// GearPosition: start bit 0, 4 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 15
// values: 0 = "Neutral", 1 = "Gear 1", 2 = "Gear 2", 3 = "Gear 3", 4 = "Gear 4", 5 = "Gear 5", 6 = "Gear 6", 15 = "Reverse"
GearPosition_raw = data[0] & 0x0F
GearPosition = GearPosition_raw

// GearboxTemp: start bit 8, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset -40, range -40 .. 215 degC
GearboxTemp_raw = data[1]
GearboxTemp = GearboxTemp_raw - 40

// TorqueConverterLock: start bit 16, 1 bit, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 1
// values: 0 = "Open", 1 = "Locked"
TorqueConverterLock_raw = data[2] & 0x01
TorqueConverterLock = TorqueConverterLock_raw

// OutputShaftSpeed: start bit 24, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.125, offset 0, range 0 .. 8191.875 rpm
OutputShaftSpeed_raw = data[3] | (data[4] << 8)
OutputShaftSpeed = OutputShaftSpeed_raw * 0.125
